servicesSection.label: What We Do
servicesSection.title: Plastering & Skimming Services
servicesSection.intro: Small repairs to full house projects — everything done properly, left clean, and ready for decorating. Add vertical job photos to each service card so customers can flick through examples.

services.title: Skimming
services.description: A smooth, thin skim coat applied over existing plaster or plasterboard — ideal for walls that need freshening up before decorating. Clean edges, flat finish.

services.title: Full Room & House Skimming
services.description: Single rooms to complete properties — walls and ceilings skimmed smooth throughout. Great for new builds, renovations, or homes being prepared for sale or redecoration.

services.title: Artex Covering
services.description: Cover over old Artex textured ceilings with a flat, smooth plastered finish — no mess, no fuss. A popular job that transforms the look of older ceilings.

services.title: Ceiling Plastering
services.description: From ceilings with minor cracks to full replastering — finished flat and ready for paint. All work protected and cleaned up properly before Ali leaves.

services.title: Plaster Repairs & Patch Work
services.description: Hairline cracks, damp patches, holes, or damaged sections neatly repaired and blended in. Small jobs are no problem — everything gets the same attention to detail.

services.title: Ready for Decorating
services.description: Every job is finished to decorator standard — smooth, clean, and properly cured. Ali won't rush a finish. When it's done, it's done right.

process.label: How It Works
process.title: Getting a Free Quote Is Simple
process.intro: Three steps and you're done. No hard sell, no hassle.

steps.title: Call or WhatsApp Ali
steps.text: Ring 07729 763555 or send a WhatsApp message — whichever suits you best.

steps.title: Send Photos or a Video
steps.text: Send a few photos or a quick video of the job via WhatsApp. That's usually enough for Ali to give you a rough price straight away.

steps.title: Get Your Free Quote
steps.text: Ali will come back to you with a price. If needed, he'll arrange a visit to take a proper look before confirming the quote.

contact.label: Get in Touch
contact.title: Contact Ali for a Free Quote
contact.intro: Call Ali, send a WhatsApp message, or check the Facebook page. For the quickest response, a call or WhatsApp message is best.
contact.tipText: The quickest way to get a rough quote is to send Ali a few photos or a short video of the job via WhatsApp. Show the walls, ceiling, any damage, and the room size if you can — Ali can usually give you a price from that without needing a visit first.
contact.tipText2: For full house quotes or larger jobs, Ali will visit in person to price it up properly before any work is confirmed.
